title: 🏥 Harrisburg Healthcare Jobs With Multiple Openings This Month
text:
7 hours ago Healthcare hiring around Harrisburg, PA is steady right now, with options from hands-on senior care to high-paying travel roles. Here are a few solid picks worth a look.
LPN Charge Nurse (Part-Time, Nights) Employer: Columbia Cottage Location: Linglestown / Harrisburg, PA Type: Part-time (11:00 pm–7:30 am, every other weekend & holiday rotation) Pay: Starting at $31.00/hour Why it’s appealing: Assisted living setting with a focus on senior care, plus holiday double-time pay , 401(k) with match , medical, dental, vision , company-paid life insurance (for full-time), and paid vacation . Great fit if you’re an LPN who wants more responsibility as a charge nurse in a smaller, home-like community. Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) Employer: Capitol Rehabilitation and Healthcare Center (supported by Marquis Health Consulting Services) Location: Harrisburg, PA Type: Full-time and part-time (6 am–2 pm, 2 pm–10 pm) Pay: $16.50–$23.00/hour (all-inclusive) + Daily Pay option Why it’s appealing: Work in a 138-bed sub-acute and long-term care center with clear values (Passion, Respect, Excellence). Offers tuition reimbursement, health/vision/dental, 401(k) with match, shift differentials, life insurance, EAP, and referral bonuses—solid choice if you want growth and stable hours.
